correctness.rationale: Every original neighborhood is the explicit m+1 vertex set. The unique opposite-layer pair and one-wing supports prove the two families of actual elementary collapses for n>=5. The reduced interface has E=m(m-1) cross edges, 2m(m-2) triangles, and connected crown-edge relation; E-1 selected triangles kill extra 1-cells, the remaining m^2-3m+1 null two-cells split as spheres because all row boundary spheres S^(m-2) are simply connected for m>=4. A cycle of bridges yields S1. Direct finite reconstruction and 23,920 checked free-face removals plus mod-two boundary ranks agree in all sixteen tested cases. This finite check is corroborative only; universal proof is independent of extrapolation.

value.rationale: This gives an all-parameter exact homotopy classification for a natural product-graph family of arbitrarily high degree, with sphere dimensions 2 and m-2 and explicit multiplicities; degree three first appears at m=5. The proof supplies a general mechanism via unique common neighbors and crown-interface relations and determines integral torsion-freeness and π1, not merely finite data or Euler characteristics.
